timer_adjudication.interpretation: The source calls PrintWallLawCensus from finish after work has stopped, and before observe_progress("exit") prints NATIVE3D_STAGE. PrintWallLawCensus opens the pre-existing Operation::Census scope and has a local clock around its wall-law sweep. Thus the exit diagnostic is included in the emitted stage/Adapt elapsed clocks after the 388.8 s decision budget has stopped trial work; subtraction leaves about 388.9 s in both N14 stage rows. The output is an observation-scope difference, not a new timing gate or a changed configured limit.
